//: Emulator config for the Playwright journeys (e2e/, .bin/audit_e2e), which start these
Separate from firebase.json so a run never touches the dev emulators' persisted
.emulator_data/, and from firebase_test.json so .bin/audit_unit (which reuses whatever
is listening on its ports and clears Firestore between cases) can never wipe a journey
mid-run. Same rules files, no import/export: all data is in-memory and gone on exit.
//ports: Every port here is two below its firebase.json counterpart, hub and logging included,
for the reason given in firebase_test.json: the hub, logging and Firestore websocket
ports aren't derived from the emulator ports, and left at their defaults a run would
take the dev emulators down with it.
